findings.title: BreakCasting tooltip still says pawns in a break use no abilities; the build 9 carve-out hands them back to vanilla
findings.detail: OthersStandDown (AbilityAI.cs:658) no longer stands vanilla down for a player pawn in a mental state unless Handles is true. With BreakCasting off, ControlOf returns None, so Handles is false and vanilla's AICanTargetNow answer stands. Vanilla's manhunter job giver casts abilities through GetAbilityJob (JobGiver_Manhunter.cs:31), so a tame animal gone manhunter with an aiCanUse ability will cast it. The AAI_BreakCasting_Tip line 'Off: your pawns in a break use no abilities' (Languages/English/Keyed/AbilityAI.xml:27) is now wrong. Change it to say that with this off, the game's own AI decides for pawns in a break.

findings.title: OpenMenu's group gathering reaches selected pawns whose gizmo is not on the button
findings.detail: For a groupAbility def, OpenMenu adds every selected pawn that has the ability and passes Offers. Vanilla only yields a pawn's ability gizmo when the pawn is drafted or the def has displayGizmoWhileUndrafted, and when no comp has ShouldHideGizmo set. So in a mixed drafted/undrafted selection the menu sets a mode on pawns the player never saw on that button. Vanilla already holds the exact set in Command_Ability.groupedCasts (private, filled by GroupAbilityCommands on the drawn gizmo, which is the one right-clicked). Read that through AccessTools.FieldRefAccess, or add the same (Drafted || displayGizmoWhileUndrafted) && GizmosVisible() check in the selector loop at AbilityAIAutocast.cs:144-146.

findings.title: With BreakCasting on, a non-aggressive break stands vanilla down while the driver also won't cast
findings.detail: For a player pawn in any mental state, ControlOf returns Control.NPC when BreakCasting is on, so Handles and OthersStandDown can be true. CanActNow (AbilityAI.cs:592) refuses every mental state except aggressive ones and PanicFlee, so in a sad wander, say, neither AI casts. Vanilla's mental-state trees rarely cast in those states, so the practical effect is small. It is only worth knowing if a host relies on its aiCanUse fallback during breaks.

findings.title: `grouped = multipleSelected && def.groupAbility` is never true
findings.detail: parms.multipleSelected comes from ShowPawnDetailsWith against the other buttons in firstGizmos. A groupAbility def collapses into one gizmo, so there is no other same-def button and multipleSelected is false. The title then falls back to command.LabelCap, which is originalLabel, the def label. The result is right, but the branch at AbilityAIAutocast.cs:197-198 never runs and its comment describes a path that doesn't happen.

findings.title: Shrunk ungrouped gizmos title the menu with a stale label
findings.detail: Command_Ability sets defaultLabel to pawnLabel or originalLabel only inside GizmoOnGUI. GizmoOnGUIShrunk goes straight to GizmoOnGUIInt, and the command is cached on the Ability. So on the shrunk path with several pawns selected, the menu title is whatever the last full-size draw left, possibly without the pawn's name, even though the menu sets only that pawn's mode. On the full-size path the Prefix also reads the label before vanilla updates it this frame, which is harmless because the value from the last frame is the same.

findings.title: Group menu's '(current)' marker and the badge reflect only the clicked pawn
findings.detail: For a grouped button, current = ModeFor(clicked.pawn, def), and Badge draws only the drawn pawn's mode. If grouped pawns have different modes, the menu doesn't show it. This is my opinion only: it may be worth a mixed marker.
